page.content:
Short pressurized shot that organizes Italian bar culture and most café menus.

How Espresso connects

  • Location: Italian coffee bar — Espresso is the defining drink of the Italian coffee bar.
  • Item: Espresso machine — The espresso machine is what makes espresso a bar drink.
  • Item: Cappuccino — Cappuccino is built on a shot of espresso and textured milk.
  • Faction: Starbucks — Starbucks scaled espresso-and-milk drinks into a global chain menu.
  • Location: Brazil — Brazilian lots are a volume base of many espresso blends.
  • Item: Coffea canephora — Many traditional espresso blends include robusta for crema and body.

What is Espresso?

Espresso is coffee extracted under pressure as a small, crema-topped shot. It is the base of cappuccino and the technical center of the barista's craft.

Key threads lead to Italian coffee bar, Espresso machine, Cappuccino, Starbucks, Brazil and Coffea canephora.
